results.title: Guess Who's Calling!
results.overview: Baptiste, a talented imitator, is unable to make a living from his art. One day, he is approached by Pierre Chozène, a famous but discreet novelist, constantly disturbed by incessant calls from his publisher, his daughter, his ex-wife... Pierre, who needs peace and quiet to write his most ambitious text, then suggests that Baptiste become his 'answering machine' by pretending to be him on the phone... Little by little, Baptiste doesn't just imitate the writer: he develops his character!

results.title: The King of the Fair
results.overview: When a market vendor is mysteriously murdered, Monarca - an unconventional detective who blends investigative instincts with paranormal gifts... and a knack for getting into trouble - steps onto the scene. Alongside the victim’s own chatty spirit, "Bode," he tackles an investigation rife with shouting matches, gossip, and revelations amidst Brazil’s liveliest street market.

results.title: Home Made Hollywood: The Life and Films of Nick Millard
results.original_title: Home Made Hollywood: The Life and Films of Nick Millard
results.overview: Documentary about the life and films of Nick Millard.

results.title: Anna Magnani – The Untold Story
results.overview: On March 21, 1956, Anna Magnani wins the Academy Award for Best Actress. She spends the night waiting for the news wandering the streets of Rome. However, an unpredictable turn of fate pushes her aside at the moment of her greatest splendor, showing her human side and the world that surrounds her. Above everything is Roberto Rossellini, "an imprint in the heart that lives on even when time has erased everything else."

results.title: Wolf Beach
results.overview: Manu works at a beach bar. Klaus won't leave the last beach chair. What seems like a clash between opposites turns suspicious when Manu doubts Klaus's presence is coincidental. Tension builds until Klaus makes a disturbing offer.

results.title: Two Cuckolds Go Swimming
results.overview: Adult film star Molly Chambers flies home to visit her mom in a small, coastal town. A simple trip, challenged by the presence of Sunshine, an embittered ex-boyfriend staying in her childhood bedroom.

results.title: Lace Larrabee: Sparkle Baby
results.overview: America's Got Talent alumnus Lace Larrabee performs for a hometown crowd in Atlanta, GA and reflects upon her years in pageants, opportunities she's realized were missed when she was younger and alternative routes her life could have taken.

results.title: Ercilia Pepín: ejemplo de enseñanza, patriotismo y dignidad
results.original_title: Ercilia Pepín: ejemplo de enseñanza, patriotismo y dignidad
results.overview: The life of Dominican teacher, patriot and activist Ercilia Pepín.

results.title: don't you forget
results.overview: Torn between bailing out her boyfriend and reaffirming her body, a trans woman chooses the world.

results.title: Ref[H*]erencias
results.overview: Short film narrated in first person about growth, loneliness, and belonging.

results.title: The Blind Reaper
results.overview: Gu Bei, a blind beggar, witnesses a horrific massacre—an entire town and a wealthy family brutally slaughtered. Moved by the kindness of Lan Qiuyao, the young heiress who once gave him a bowl of rice, he sets out to uncover the truth behind the tragedy. However, the real culprit, Nan Zhulang, attempts to silence him by force.  When Lan Qiuyao is brutally murdered, the fire long dormant in Gu Bei’s heart ignites once more. He sheds his humble guise and returns as the legendary killing god of the battlefield—"Ye Bu Shou" (The Unyielding Reaper). With his unmatched skills and unshakable sense of justice, he seeks vengeance for the slaughtered townspeople of Qing Shi and the thirty members of the Lan family, delivering bloody retribution to those who deserve it.

results.title: Ebony & Ivory
results.overview: Two musical legends gather at a Scottish Cottage on The Mull Of Kintyre for a tense summit to discuss a potential collaboration that will ultimately result in a Global Number One smash hit single.

results.title: Natalie Portman – Vom Kinderstar zur Hollywood-Ikone
results.original_title: Natalie Portman – Vom Kinderstar zur Hollywood-Ikone
results.overview: Portrait of an actress in constant evolution who, through risk-taking and side steps, has emancipated herself from the overly polished image forged by the Star Wars trilogy to become a talented and committed artist, a recognized ambassador for the feminist cause.

results.title: Imprint
results.overview: Chance encounters can leave a lasting imprint, like ink on paper. At 13, Duncan Major met artist Tara Bryan and discovered a shared passion for letterpress printing that shaped his life. In her memory, Duncan created Imprint, a poetic animated film that serves as a heartfelt tribute. Using the letterpress and craft material she passed down to him, the film brings hand-printed art to life with vibrant animation, evocative imagery and a beautifully designed soundscape. Imprint celebrates how the relationships we build echo outward, leaving an enduring legacy.

results.title: Odekake Kozame Movie
results.original_title: 映画 おでかけ子ザメ とかいのおともだち
results.overview: Movie based on the Odekake Kozame manga and sequel to the 2023 anime that follows the nostalgic everyday adventures of a young shark.

results.title: Gloria
results.overview: Gloria, a Chinese woman in her 70s living alone and struggling with her memory, finds newfound purpose in teaching herself Spanish.

results.title: There's No Place Like Christmas
results.overview: Grace Sawyer is a big city realtor returns to her hometown of Evergreen Falls to lead the local realty office, just as the team nears an annual sales goal that would win them a dream vacation. On Grace’s first day, she accidentally ruins a once-in-a-year sunset photo for local photographer Luke Davies, who also shoots listings for the agency. Will a chance at owning her dream home and snagging a permanent role managing the firm in her small town lead Grace to love and a future she never expected.

results.title: Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri
results.original_title: तू मेरी मैं तेरा मैं तेरा तू मेरी
results.overview: When a carefree NRI wedding planner and a headstrong novelist collide during a wild summer in Croatia, sparks fly in ways neither expected. What begins as playful clashes soon transforms into something deeper – only to be tested when love, family, and tradition pull them in opposite directions.

results.title: Enron
results.overview: The surreal and darkly funny rise and fall of energy darling Enron, whose multi-billion dollar loss changed the financial landscape forever.

results.title: Sheet Talk
results.overview: At a crossroads in their relationship, Oscar and his ghoul-friend must decide what the next step in their relationship is.
